description: Department of Forest Conservation - State lands named Neketunuwewa, Kahatagaswewa, Ataweeragollewa as Reserved Forests - Neketunuwewa, Kahatagaswewa and Ataweeragollewa reserved forests are subjected to the Single Central of the Conservator General of Forests
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of state land as a Reserved Forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance. It contains detailed geographic coordinates and boundaries for the land parcel, which is characteristic of land-related gazettes. While it mentions a State Minister, this is only in the context of who issued the order and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government classification type.
